name: box-carousel
title: Box Carousel
description: A 3D cube whose faces are photos; buttons, arrow keys or a drag rotate it a quarter turn to reveal the next image.
use: Photos deserve a playful, tactile reveal and the page can spare a square stage.
avoid: Fixed pixel width and height props mean it will not scale with its container.
a11y: Arrow keys rotate it and a live region announces the item, but the focus ring is removed and the describedby target is missing. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rectangular photo floats in a dark stage, briefly showing the side faces of a cube as it turns. Two small pill buttons, Prev and Next, sit centred beneath it.
behaves: Pressing Next or Prev, dragging the photo, or using the arrow keys rotates the cube ninety degrees on its vertical axis and snaps to the next picture; a drag springs back to its nearest face.
customise: Pass an items array of image or video sources plus width, height, rotation direction, drag and autoplay settings; the faces' styling needs a source edit.
weight: light: Only four media faces and motion values; no per-frame canvas or large scene.
